title: Bigu kanji content
description: Shape of a data/kanji.json file, as loaded by kanji.js.

id.description: Unique id, e.g. "kj-001". Used as the progress-store key.

level.description: This entry's own JLPT level, shown as its .jlpt-tag badge. Optional, and there is no file-level fallback — an entry without one is unleveled, which kanji.js files under its "Outside JLPT" chip and renders with no badge.

onyomi.description: On'yomi reading in katakana. Empty string if none — kanji.js only renders whichever of onyomi/kunyomi is non-empty.

kunyomi.description: Kun'yomi reading in hiragana. Empty string if none.

examples.description: Optional list of example words for the kanji detail view's Examples section. If omitted, kanji.js falls back to a single-item list built from `example`.

related.description: Optional list of related kanji characters for the detail view's Related Kanji section. Each renders as a jump-to-entry chip when the character exists elsewhere in this same file, plain text otherwise.
